title: Alexis de Salo & Tanner: God in the Virgin not only by essence/power/presence or grace but by Identity
source_text: LXVIII. Eo quoque referri potest quod dicunt Alexis de Salo & Tanner de Argento, Deum esse in Virgine, non solum per essentiam, potentiam, & praesentiam, ut in caeteris creaturis; nec solum per gratiam, ut in anima justi: sed modo longe excellentiori, id est, per Identitatem.
pass_a_gloss: To that also can be referred what Alexis de Salo and Tanner de Argento say, that God is in the Virgin not only by essence, power, and presence, as in other creatures; nor only by grace, as in the soul of the just: but in a far more excellent mode, that is, by Identity.
pass_b_english: Alexis de Salo and Tanner: God dwells in Mary beyond essence, power, presence, or grace—by Identity.

choices.why: Distinctive fourth mode beyond the scholastic trio + grace.
